name: Cetaphil Gentle Skin Cleanser for Dry to Normal Skin & Sensitive Skin 236ml (Made in Canada)
description:
Care for your sensitive skin with Cetaphil Gentle Skin Cleanser, a creamy formula designed to cleanse gently while maintaining hydration. Clinically proven to protect against dryness, it effectively removes dirt, makeup, and impurities without irritating the skin.

Key Features:

Gentle & Effective Cleansing: Micellar Technology removes impurities while preserving skin’s moisture.

Hydrating Formula: Clinically proven to provide continuous hydration, leaving skin soft and moisturized.

Dermatologist-Backed Ingredients: Enriched with Niacinamide (Vitamin B3), Panthenol (Vitamin B5), and Glycerin to strengthen and protect sensitive skin.

Clinically Tested: 95% of users felt it gently cleansed their skin.

Skin Type: Dry to normal, sensitive skin

Dermatologist Tested: Safe and gentle for daily use.

Made in Canada
